text:
maya: Hey team — hitting flaky Connection reset by peer in the Android sample when SDK retry is enabled. Repro steps below.

josh: Which endpoint and retry config? stacktrace?

maya: Streaming chat (server-sent tokens). Emulator + Pixel 4X show intermittent socket closed/reset and then our retry layer fires immediately causing duplicate/corrupted attempts.

maya: log:
```
W/okhttp.OkHttpClient: java.net.SocketException: Connection reset by peer
 at okhttp3.internal.connection.RealConnection.connectSocket(RealConnection.kt:XXX)
 Caused by: java.net.SocketException: Connection reset by peer
```

alec: Are you using OkHttp's retryOnConnectionFailure=true plus our SDK RetryPolicy? Those can conflict for streaming/non-idempotent calls.

maya: Yeah, SDK has RetryPolicy + Retrofit CallAdapter. OkHttp default client is unmodified. If OkHttp retries low-level and our SDK retries at higher layer, we end up reusing/closing streams incorrectly.

sam: Is generate (non-streaming) impacted too?

maya: Mostly streaming but saw one image upload test where retry resulted in duplicate create (409).

josh: Short-term: set OkHttpClient.retryOnConnectionFailure(false) in sample and let SDK handle retries, or expose an SDK flag to disable internal retries on Android. Also verify callTimeout/readTimeout interplay.

maya: Tried retryOnConnectionFailure(false) + SDK retry still saw resets because streaming doesn't resume; a full restart is needed. I patched sample to set dispatcher maxRequestsPerHost(6) and increase connection pool to 6 entries — that cut occurrences.

alec: Two follow-ups: 1) add disableAutomaticRetries boolean to Kotlin SDK builder for Android; 2) document recommended OkHttp dispatcher, connection pool, and timeouts in Android sample README.

maya: Also noticed token-refresh race: if a 401 happens while retry queued, two concurrent refreshes can occur and retried call may use old token. Not the old token race thread but related due to retries.

josh: Do we have single-flight refresh on Android? JVM SDK locks, but Android coroutines can cause double refresh if cancel+resume interleave.

alec: I'll add a coroutine-safe refresh lock and unit tests.

ci-bot: CI queued: android-emulator tests on branch fix/android-retries (build #4842).

sam: Can we push a sample update and opt-in flag this week? Keep defaults until tests pass.

maya: Plan: PR 1 - disable SDK retries by default in Android sample + README; PR 2 - add builder flag + tests for token single-flight. Opening PRs today.

josh: Also add a note in migration guide about idempotency tokens and retry interactions.

alec: I'll make a ticket to rework streaming retry semantics (resume vs full restart). Thanks for the repro and patch, @maya. :thumbsup:

maya: Sending PR links now.
